texts.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetStarName]系最近发现了一颗彗星。
在[Root.Capital.GetName]表面清晰可见的这颗彗星在大众心中激起了强烈的反响。

几乎无人能否认，在[GetCycleName]轮回中出现这样的一个天体毫无疑问是[GetCycleAttitude]的原因。
texts.en:
A comet was recently detected in the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system.
Clearly visible from the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName], its appearance was met with an intense reaction from the planet's population.

There is little disagreement that the occurrence of such a celestial event during a [GetCycleName] is a cause for [GetCycleAttitude].

texts.zh:
近日，[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系发现一颗带有气体和尘埃尾部的小型天体。

它的消逝平淡无奇。
texts.en:
A small celestial object with pronounced gaseous and particulate tails was recently observed in the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system.

Its passing was uneventful.

texts.zh:
一道亮光划过[Root.Capital.GetName]的夜空，它柔和的弧线与缓慢运转的繁星们交相辉映，形成鲜明的对比。

[Root.Capital.GetName]的居民将其视作上天认可我们的证明，也是对我们事业的微妙祝福。
texts.en:
A light was seen moving in the night sky of [Root.Capital.GetName], its gentle arc standing in stark contrast to the slow revolution of the stars.

The citizens of [Root.Capital.GetName] see it as proof of recognition by the powers that be, and a subtle blessing of our cause.

texts.zh:
一颗彗星从平流层顶部擦过，熊熊燃烧的烈焰之羽炙烤着[Root.Capital.GetName]的苍穹。其天体轨迹展现出的强大力量给首都的人们留下了无比深刻的印象。

他们用这条势不可挡的航迹来比喻[Root.GetName]终将攀上星系无上霸权的必然性。
texts.en:
A fierce plume of flame sears the heavens of [Root.Capital.GetName] as a comet skirts the upper stratosphere. The sheer power evident in its cosmic trajectory has made a profound impression on the capital's populace.

They liken the intractability of its path to the inevitability of the [Root.GetName]'s ascension to galactic supremacy.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]天生就很有好奇心，[Root.Capital.GetName]上空划过的彗星在我们的民众中引起了广泛的恭谦之情。

他们热切地希望这样的奇迹终有一天能让全星系的所有生物团结一心。
texts.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are naturally curious, and the appearance of a comet in the sky above [Root.Capital.GetName] has sown a widespread sense of humility among our people.

It is their fervent hope that wonders like this one will someday bring all beings of the galaxy together.

texts.zh:
一颗彗星带着光亮的尾迹划破了[Root.Capital.GetName]的地平线，宛如来自遥远星星的特使。[Root.GetSpeciesName]民众为之欢欣鼓舞，认为它冥冥之中预示着我们在宇宙中并不孤单。

他们比以往任何时候都更加支持[Root.GetName]的雄心，以涨开双臂迎接整个星系。
texts.en:
A comet blazes a trail across [Root.Capital.GetName]'s horizon, a bright envoy from distant stars. The [Root.GetSpeciesName] people find great joy in this reminder, vague as it is, that we are not alone in this universe.

They are more supportive than ever of the [Root.GetName]'s ambition to greet the galaxy with open arms.

texts.zh:
一颗骇人的彗星在[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空中游荡。那一道久久未能消散的弧线，残酷地提醒着[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我们难得独善其身。茫茫宇宙中，未知的令人惊骇也许比我们想的更加迫近了。

我们应该将其视作一个信号，并对保持对外星生物毫不松懈的警惕态度。
texts.en:
A dread comet haunts the skies of [Root.Capital.GetName]. Its implacable arc is a harsh reminder to the [Root.GetSpeciesName] that we are not alone, and that unknowable horrors from beyond the stars may be closer than they appear.

We must take this as a sign to remain ever vigilant against alien influence.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的许多团体都观测到一颗彗星飞快地掠过[Root.Capital.GetName]的天空。这颗孤独又渺小的天体却令许人们感到巨大的不安。[Root.GetSpeciesName]与[Root.GetSpeciesName]互相确认着自己并不孤单以寻求慰藉。

他们相信，这预兆着[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]社会将要面临孤立和离散的命运。
texts.en:
Groups of [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] watched a comet streak across the sky of [Root.Capital.GetName]. The appearance of this lonely stellar object caused seemingly disproportionate distress, and [Root.GetSpeciesName] turned to [Root.GetSpeciesName] for assurance that they are not alone.

They are convinced that this is a sign of coming isolation and splintering of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] society.

texts.zh:
一颗孤傲的彗星在[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系中滑行，在[Root.Capital.GetName]上清晰可见。它在宇宙中一路穿行，充满活力，势不可挡。

这正是每位[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都想为之奋斗的理想。
texts.en:
A lone, proud comet soars through the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system, clearly visible from [Root.Capital.GetName]. It forges its own path through the cosmos, vibrant and ever undeterred.

This is the ideal which all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] strive for.

texts.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]上的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]单元报告观测到了一个正在气化的小型冰质星系内天体，其赤纬交角为10.3度，赤经2度54分8秒。

经测量，该天体相到恒星的距离大约为3.75个天文单位，其彗发的尺寸及可见度值得注意。这个天体的尺寸经计算大约为5×10×6立方公里。该次观测事件正常结束，没有意外发生。
texts.en:
Planetside [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] units on [Root.Capital.GetName] report the sighting of a small, icy solar system body exhibiting outgassing at two hours, fifty-four minutes, eight seconds right ascension, ten-point-three degrees declination.

The distance of the body has been triangulated at roughly three-point-seven-five astronomical units to the sun, and the size and visibility of the body's coma have been classified as noteworthy. The body's dimensions are calculated to be approximately five by ten by six kilometers. The sighting event concluded without incident.

summary.text:
# 发现彗星 / Comet Sighted

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/country_events_2.txt:70-339 · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

随时间随机发生（平均600个月，约50年）。仅限普通国家（非堕落帝国等），非蜂巢意识，且每个国家只会发生一次（had_comet旗标）（country_events_2.txt:106-116）。

Random over time (mean 600 months, about 50 years). Only normal countries (not fallen empires etc.), not hive minds, and once per country (had_comet flag) (country_events_2.txt:106-116).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单个窗口：一颗彗星划过天空。正文随信仰与伦理变化（迷信信仰、各类狂热伦理）。

A single window: a comet crosses the sky. The text varies with belief and ethics (superstitious beliefs, each fanatic ethic).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

选项按伦理而定，彼此互斥：普通玩家得团结；狂热军国者/灵性者/平等主义者得首都1800天的正面修正，狂热排外者/威权者得负面修正；狂热物质主义者得物理研究；机器帝国得团结。迷信信仰帝国另有选项，并在事件后获得13年的“彗星预兆/好运”修正（取决于是否有“预兆之环”）。

Options depend on ethics and are mutually exclusive: ordinary empires get unity; fanatic militarist/spiritualist/egalitarian a positive capital modifier for 1800 days, fanatic xenophobe/authoritarian a negative one; fanatic materialists physics research; machine empires unity. Superstitious empires have their own options and, after the event, a 13-year omen or fortune modifier (depending on Cycle of Omens).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

见选项（trigger）：是否迷信信仰、是否狂热伦理、是否机器帝国、是否集群意识。

See the option triggers: superstitious beliefs, fanatic ethics, machine empire, gestalt.
